{
  "name": "jp-lit-mcp",
  "version": "0.19.0",
  "private": false,
  "license": "MIT",
  "type": "module",
  "description": "MCP server and Skills for Japanese literature and humanities research across NDL, CiNii, J-STAGE, IRDB, and related sources",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git+https://github.com/itarunnn/jp-lit-mcp.git"
  },
  "bin": {
    "jp-lit-mcp": "dist/src/index.js",
    "jp-lit-mcp-install-skills": "scripts/install-skills.mjs",
    "jp-lit-tei-reader": "scripts/tei-reader.mjs",
    "jp-lit-iiif": "scripts/iiif-workbench.mjs"
  },
  "files": [
    "dist/",
    "docs/api-notes/",
    "docs/install/",
    "docs/feedback.md",
    "docs/ndl-digital-collections.md",
    "docs/project-status.md",
    "docs/reference.md",
    "docs/regional-public-library-research.md",
    "docs/source-usage-conditions.md",
    "docs/usage-guide.md",
    "docs/tei-reader.md",
    "docs/iiif-workbench.md",
    "docs/iiif-cli-reference.md",
    "docs/book-structure.md",
    "docs/third-party-notices.md",
    "docs/releases/v0.15.0.md",
    "docs/releases/v0.15.1.md",
    "docs/releases/v0.15.2.md",
    "docs/releases/v0.16.0.md",
    "docs/releases/v0.17.0.md",
    "docs/releases/v0.18.0.md",
    "docs/releases/v0.19.0.md",
    "packages/tei-reader/.python-version",
    "packages/tei-reader/pyproject.toml",
    "packages/tei-reader/uv.lock",
    "packages/tei-reader/README.md",
    "packages/tei-reader/examples/sample.xml",
    "packages/tei-reader/tei_reader/__init__.py",
    "packages/tei-reader/tei_reader/__main__.py",
    "packages/tei-reader/tei_reader/document.py",
    "packages/tei-reader/tei_reader/facsimile.py",
    "packages/tei-reader/tei_reader/locator.py",
    "packages/tei-reader/tei_reader/model.py",
    "packages/tei-reader/tei_reader/operations.py",
    "packages/tei-reader/tei_reader/page_ranges.py",
    "packages/tei-reader/tei_reader/line_ranges.py",
    "packages/tei-reader/tei_reader/protocol.py",
    "packages/tei-reader/tei_reader/references.py",
    "packages/tei-reader/tei_reader/tree.py",
    "packages/book-structure/.python-version",
    "packages/book-structure/pyproject.toml",
    "packages/book-structure/uv.lock",
    "packages/book-structure/README.md",
    "packages/book-structure/book_structure/__init__.py",
    "packages/book-structure/book_structure/__main__.py",
    "packages/book-structure/book_structure/sqlite_export.py",
    "packages/iiif-ocr-modal/.python-version",
    "packages/iiif-ocr-modal/pyproject.toml",
    "packages/iiif-ocr-modal/uv.lock",
    "packages/iiif-ocr-modal/README.md",
    "packages/iiif-ocr-modal/iiif_ocr_modal/__init__.py",
    "packages/iiif-ocr-modal/iiif_ocr_modal/__main__.py",
    "packages/iiif-ocr-modal/iiif_ocr_modal/contracts.py",
    "packages/iiif-ocr-modal/iiif_ocr_modal/cloud.py",
    "packages/iiif-ocr-modal/iiif_ocr_modal/worker.py",
    "packages/iiif-image-analysis/.python-version",
    "packages/iiif-image-analysis/pyproject.toml",
    "packages/iiif-image-analysis/uv.lock",
    "packages/iiif-image-analysis/README.md",
    "packages/iiif-image-analysis/iiif_image/__init__.py",
    "packages/iiif-image-analysis/iiif_image/__main__.py",
    "packages/iiif-image-analysis/iiif_image/analysis.py",
    "skills/",
    "scripts/install-skills.mjs",
    "scripts/tei-reader.mjs",
    "scripts/iiif-workbench.mjs",
    "scripts/iiif-images.mjs",
    "scripts/iiif-ocr-modal.mjs",
    "scripts/install-skills.ps1",
    "scripts/install-skills.sh",
    "README.md",
    "LICENSE",
    "mcp-config.example.json"
  ],
  "scripts": {
    "build": "tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/build-iiif-assets.mjs",
    "dev": "tsx src/index.ts",
    "prepack": "npm run build",
    "smoke:mcp": "tsx scripts/smoke-mcp.ts",
    "smoke:mcp:offline": "cross-env SMOKE_OFFLINE=1 tsx scripts/smoke-mcp.ts",
    "smoke:mcp:live-matrix": "cross-env SMOKE_LIVE_MATRIX=1 SMOKE_LIVE=1 tsx scripts/smoke-mcp.ts",
    "smoke:calil-mcp": "tsx scripts/smoke-calil-mcp.ts",
    "test": "vitest run",
    "test:tei": "uv run --directory packages/tei-reader --frozen python -m unittest discover -s tests -v",
    "test:book": "uv run --directory packages/book-structure --frozen python -m unittest discover -s tests -v",
    "test:ocr-modal": "uv run --directory packages/iiif-ocr-modal --frozen python -m unittest discover -s tests -v",
    "test:images": "node scripts/iiif-images.mjs --test",
    "test:watch": "vitest",
    "typecheck:scripts": "tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json",
    "skills:install": "node scripts/install-skills.mjs"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk": "^1.32.2",
    "fast-xml-parser": "^5.10.1",
    "zod": "^3.23.8"
  },
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=22"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/node": "^24.0.0",
    "cross-env": "^10.0.0",
    "mirador": "4.2.6",
    "tsx": "^4.19.0",
    "typescript": "^5.8.0",
    "vitest": "^4.1.12",
    "yaml": "^2.9.0"
  }
}
